up_instructions: The schema is applied automatically on server startup via db.exec() in server.js. No manual migration step is needed. Tables created: users (id, email, password_hash, created_at) and high_scores (id, user_id FK, score, created_at).
down_instructions: To revert: drop tables high_scores and users from the SQLite database file. Example: sqlite3 data/pong.db 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS high_scores; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users;'
notes: Schema is defined inline in server.js using better-sqlite3 db.exec(). The CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pattern makes it idempotent. The data directory is created automatically if it does not exist.
